name: bitripay
description: BitriPay - launch your own QR code money transfer business with wallets, card payments, merchant tools, agents, web + admin + mobile apps.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @bitripay/api && npm run build -w @bitripay/web && npm run build -w @bitripay/admin
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @bitripay/shared && npm run build -w @bitripay/bitriqr && npm run build -w @bitripay/sdk && npm run build -w @bitripay/checkout-js
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @bitripay/web && npm run build -w @bitripay/admin
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @bitripay/api" "npm run dev -w @bitripay/web" "npm run dev -w @bitripay/admin"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:shared && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:shared: npm run test -w @bitripay/shared && npm run test -w @bitripay/bitriqr && npm run test -w @bitripay/sdk && npm run test -w @bitripay/checkout-js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @bitripay/api && npm run typecheck -w @bitripay/web && npm run typecheck -w @bitripay/admin
